description: This file defines type aliases and macros for creating conformance profiles and archetypes used in the Abseil C++ library, specifically for internal type conformance testing and profile combination.

methods.name: ABSL_INTERNAL_PROFILE_AND_ARCHETYPE_ALIAS
methods.description: Macro to create a profile and archetype alias with a given name and profile type.

methods.name: ExpandBasicProfiles
methods.description: Template alias to expand a receiver template with basic profiles.

methods.name: ExpandBasicEquatableProfiles
methods.description: Template alias to expand a receiver template with basic profiles that are also equatable.

methods.name: ExpandBasicComparableProfiles
methods.description: Template alias to expand a receiver template with basic profiles that are also comparable.

methods.name: ExpandBasicHashableProfiles
methods.description: Template alias to expand a receiver template with basic profiles that are also hashable.

methods.name: ExpandBasicDefaultConstructibleProfiles
methods.description: Template alias to expand a receiver template with basic profiles that are also default constructible.

methods.name: ExpandSupportedProfiles
methods.description: Template alias to expand a receiver template with all supported profiles in Abseil.
